temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl appears stressed and overwhelmed by paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Maria offers help, and Cheryl accepts gratefully.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had not yet formed a specific belief about Cheryl being overwhelmed by this project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns Cheryl is struggling with the project workload and is open to receiving help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is overwhelmed but receptive to assistance, and it is appropriate for Maria to help her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and sympathy, then willingness and relief at being able to assist.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing more confident after the help. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl for a leadership role, and Cheryl thanks Maria and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl was previously overwhelmed but has been improving with support; she is considering whether Cheryl is ready for more responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria observes Cheryl's improved confidence and sees Cheryl willingly accept the leadership role while appreciating Maria's confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, confident, and ready to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria privately checks in with Cheryl, who says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that suggesting Cheryl for leadership may have felt like overstepping or pressured Cheryl.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's response resolves Maria's worry: Cheryl did not feel pressured and values Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl appreciates Maria's honesty and support, and there are no hard feelings about the leadership suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxiety and concern, then relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clarify her support and maintain a trusting, supportive relationship with Cheryl.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project. Cheryl agrees enthusiastically, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and she hopes they can continue collaborating effectively.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl welcomes co-leading and expresses that Maria's guidance matters to her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can support each other as co-leaders and are a strong team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects, and Cheryl says she would love that and is excited.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and they make a great team; she hopes Cheryl will want to continue working together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl confirms she loves the idea of future collaboration and values working with Maria.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong, mutually valued, and likely to continue successfully in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
